name: mdx-activation-router
purpose: After an install is claimed and a model is connected, ask the operator the one thing MDx cannot detect - what they came to do - and route them there. A one-time chooser, not a home screen.

one_time_trigger.show_when: owner_claimed == true AND model_connected == true AND no setup.track_chosen receipt exists
one_time_trigger.after_choice: the front door routes to Twin by default; the router stays revisitable but is not the home surface
